bloodFinder.noResultsHint: Try a wider radius, another component, or a compatible group.
bloodFinder.compatibleBody: A patient with {{group}} can usually receive: {{groups}}. Your clinician decides what is actually transfused.
bloodFinder.safetyBody: Blood stock is reported by each facility and can change within minutes. Call before travelling, and never delay emergency care to search here.
bloodFinder.myRequestsEmpty: You have no blood requests yet.

request.title: Request Blood Units
request.subtitle: This reserves your place at the counter. No payment is taken and no unit is issued until the facility confirms.
request.urgency: How soon do you need it?
request.successBody: Show reference {{reference}} at {{facility}}. They will confirm before you travel.
request.cancelledBody: Your request has been withdrawn. The facility keeps a record of it.
request.paymentNote: OpesCare takes no payment for blood. Any fee is settled with the facility directly.
request.clinicalNote: Blood is issued by the facility after its own checks — this request is not a cross-match or a clinical approval.

urgencyHints.routine: Planned care — within the next few days.
urgencyHints.emergency: Needed now — a life is at risk.

request.emergencyWarning: Sending this does not dispatch an ambulance or hold a bed. If a life is at risk, call the facility now and go there.
request.notAvailableBody: This facility is no longer reporting {{group}} · {{component}} as available. The listing may have been reserved or updated since your search ran.
request.next1: The blood bank reviews your request and confirms or declines it.
request.next2: The outcome appears under My Requests on the Blood Finder.
request.next3: Bring the reference and the patient's Health ID to the counter.
request.openRequestsHint: Your open requests are listed on the Blood Finder screen.

errors.BLOOD_NOT_AVAILABLE: This facility is no longer reporting that blood type as available.
errors.TOO_MANY_OPEN_REQUESTS: You already have the maximum number of open blood requests.
errors.REQUEST_ALREADY_OPEN: You already have an open request for this blood type at this facility.
errors.REQUEST_NOT_CANCELLABLE: This request can no longer be cancelled.
errors.FACILITY_NOT_FOUND: This facility is no longer listed.
errors.REQUEST_NOT_FOUND: This request could not be found.
errors.generic: The request could not be completed. Please try again.

bloodFinder.locationDenied: Location unavailable — choose a city instead.
bloodFinder.emergencyBody: Do not wait on a blood request. Get to the nearest emergency department, or call a hospital directly — this screen only shows stock that facilities reported themselves.

empty.body: Facilities report their own blood stock and not all of them keep it current. An empty result means nothing was reported here — not that there is definitely no blood.
empty.checking: Checking the rest of the country…
empty.nationwideFound_one: {{count}} facility elsewhere in Cameroon reports it
empty.nationwideFound_other: {{count}} facilities elsewhere in Cameroon report it
empty.nationwideNone: No facility anywhere on OpesCare currently reports {{group}} · {{component}} as available.
empty.nationwideNoneHint: Ask the hospital treating the patient to place a formal inter-facility request — they can reach blood banks this app cannot.
empty.failed: Couldn't check the rest of the country.

appUpdate.blockedBody: This version of OpesCare is no longer supported. Please update to keep using your health record.
appUpdate.availableBody: Update OpesCare to get the latest features and security fixes.
appUpdate.storeUnavailable: Please update OpesCare from your app store to continue.

offline.title: Offline access
offline.subtitle: Keep a limited, encrypted copy of your record on this device, so it is there when the network is not.
offline.bannerNoData: Offline — no saved data on this device
offline.notEnabledBody: Nothing from your record is stored on this device yet. Turn it on to keep a copy for when you have no signal.
offline.modeFullBody: Profile, upcoming appointments, medications, allergies and your emergency profile. The device authorisation renews every 24 hours.
offline.modeEmergencyBody: Blood group, allergies and active conditions only. Expires after 6 hours and every use is flagged for review.
offline.policyEncryptionOn: Encrypted by this device's secure storage
offline.policyReviewNote: This authorisation is flagged for review by OpesCare.
offline.syncOfflineHint: Reconnect to sync — your saved copy is still available.
offline.outboxBody: Changes you made without a connection. They are sent to OpesCare for reconciliation when you reconnect.
offline.disableBody: Removes the saved copy and this device's authorisation.
offline.webNotice: This is the web preview. Saved data is kept in browser storage, which is not encrypted — use the mobile app for real offline access.
offline.privacyNote: OpesCare records which device holds a copy and for how long. The copy expires on its own and you can erase it at any time.
offline.errorEnable: Could not turn on offline access. Please try again.
offline.errorSync: Could not sync. Please try again.
offline.errorNeedsConnection: You need a connection to do that.
